name: Browser agent that learns the API

mentions.name: Browser agent that learns the API
mentions.description: This browser agent learns the APIs of web apps instead of relying on their UI, working like a perfect MCP for each web app. By operating at the API level rather than clicking through the interface, it runs agent tasks much faster than UI-driven browser agents like Claude in the browser.
mentions.problem: UI-based browser agents such as Claude in the browser are super slow because they just rely on the UI; learning each web app's API removes that bottleneck and makes the agent much faster.
mentions.source_excerpt: A browser agent that learns the API :) Things like Claude in the browser are super slow, mostly because they just rely on the UI. With MCP they're much better. By learning the API it's like having a perfect MCP for each web app, making it much faster.
mentions.author: korabs
